contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy nummus of Valens (AD 364-378) (Reece period 19). Reverse legend is mostly illegible but would have read [SECVRITAS REI PVBLI]CAE. Reverse shows Victory advancing left, holding a wreath in front and palm. Mint unclear. Obverse legend is (D N VALEN - S P F AVG). Obverse shows an unclear diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right.
